_comment: The Pip (lqe, LANA.cpp) build the client packages at <resources>/pip (electron-pip-supervisor.js), built by scripts/build-pip.sh on a matching computer with LANA.cpp's distribution contract. The v3.0.0 tag was MOVED on 2026-11-12T17:46:13Z from 8f1970cdd11e to this commit (graph reuse for one-token decode, on by default, about 10 percent faster single-stream with identical output; faster batched GPU decode; a dense-model batched decode crash fixed; no new flag or settings key). Earlier moves the same day: bb191effb26c added --gpu-inexact, 8f1970cdd11e the D-41 Metal defaults (adaptive prefill on, 512-row busy chunk). The tag name alone cannot tell a build before a move from one after, so scripts/build-pip.sh refuses a checkout whose v3.0.0 resolves to any other commit (fetch with git fetch --tags --force). Change the commit only together with a rebuild of every platform's sha256.

vulkanLoader._comment: The Khronos Vulkan loader (vulkan-1.dll) the Windows package ships in pip/vulkan-fallback, NOT beside lqe.exe: Windows searches an application's own folder before System32, so a copy beside lqe.exe would put every computer with a graphics driver on this older loader. lqe.exe is built with LQE_VULKAN=ON and imports vulkan-1.dll, so a Windows computer without a graphics driver that installs the loader (a VM, a server, the basic display driver) could not start it (0xC0000135). electron-pip-supervisor.js windowsStart runs lqe.exe --version as it is, and only when a DLL is missing runs it again with this folder first on PATH (searched after System32, so it only fills the gap), then starts the servers with that PATH. Built by LunarG from Khronos's Vulkan-Loader and distributed as the Vulkan Runtime components; 1.3.296.0 is the newest runtime components archive LunarG publishes (approved source, 2026-11-12). scripts/fetch-vulkan-loader.js takes it at build time only, checks the archive against the sha256 LunarG publishes (sha256Source) and the file against sha256 below; the app never downloads it.
